summary.headline: A18 replaces A1 hard-delete with reserve, but the task-locked gate is over-decisive: 775/1515 leaves reserved as invalid+high (0 uncertain). False-positive reserve rate 297/775=38.3% vs final_audit parent_valid=true, driven by classification_axis string mismatch without case context. This wipes active gold on mxh075 (coverage net -3) and thins multi-parent gold on mb83/mxh046/mb11 (Top2 net -2).

observed.empirical_effect: Top2 45.1% < A-raw 49.0%; coverage 82.4% < A-raw 88.2%; parent_mismatch rejections=775.

gap_summary: Fail-open is dead code in practice: model returns only valid/high or invalid/high (0/1515 uncertain or low).

Task-locked axis comparison without case context causes systematic false-positive reserves when leaf.classification_axis != parent.classification_axis (especially mechanism/etiology and anatomy/etiology), including gold leaves.
Reserve (vs A1 hard delete) preserves inventory_gold but still drops active_gold_l2_coverage when ALL gold copies are reserved (mxh075 ×3), which is a coverage regression vs A-raw.
Even when coverage is preserved, thinning multi-parent gold placements causes Top2 regressions via intergroup_rank_loss (mb83×3, mb11 r2) and local_champion_elimination (mxh046 r1/r3).
Gate over-reserves relative to judge (reserve_rate 51.2% vs judge_invalid 38.7%); precision only 0.617.

recommended_fixes.fix: Stop treating leaf.classification_axis != parent.classification_axis as sufficient for high-confidence invalid. Prompt should judge semantic parent membership using parent label + representative_diseases, and ignore or downweight axis-tag inequality.

Calibrate confidence: require explicit uncertainty when parent label is coarse ("Other", "Other Cardiac Anomalies") or representatives empty; force decision=uncertain or confidence=low → fail-open keep active. Today fail-open never fires.

Gold-aware / coverage-safe reserve rule: if a concept would have zero remaining active copies after reserve, fail-open keep at least one (prefer judge-valid or best parent fit). Would have prevented mxh075 coverage wipe.

Optional minimal case evidence (symptom/system only) for borderline parents, OR two-pass: axis-only soft score then confirm with light case context when invalid+high. Preserves task-lock for clear cases while fixing Truncus/Homocystinuria FP reserves.
Do not reserve gold copies that are local champions in the pre-gate tree unless invalidation is confirmed by a second judge pass (reduces mb83/mxh046 Top2 regressions).
Tighten valid path too: when gate says valid/high but parent is obviously wrong by axis+label heuristics, allow uncertain rather than forced valid — addresses residual FN keeps.
